ExecutorStart.overview: Entry point that must be called at the beginning of any execution of any query plan, providing a hook mechanism for plugins while delegating to standard_ExecutorStart.

standard_ExecutorStart.overview: Standard implementation of ExecutorStart that creates EState, sets up parameters, snapshots, triggers, and calls InitPlan to build the plan state tree.

ExecutorRun.overview: Main routine of the executor module that accepts a query descriptor and executes the query plan, providing a hook mechanism for plugins.

standard_ExecutorRun.overview: Standard implementation of ExecutorRun that sets up the per-query context, invokes ExecutePlan, and handles instrumentation timing.

ExecutorFinish.overview: Must be called after the last ExecutorRun call to perform cleanup operations such as firing AFTER triggers.

ExecutorEnd.overview: Hook-enabled wrapper function that must be called at the end of execution of any query plan for cleanup.

InitPlan.overview: Initializes the query execution plan by opening files, allocating storage, setting up execution state, and building the plan state tree via ExecInitNode.

ExecutePlan.overview: Processes the query plan until a specified number of tuples have been retrieved, calling ExecProcNode repeatedly on the root plan node.

ExecEndPlan.overview: Cleans up at end of an ExecutorRun, releasing result relations, closing range table relations, and calling ExecEndNode on the plan tree.

ExecInitNode.overview: Recursively initializes all nodes in a plan tree, dispatching on NodeTag to create the corresponding PlanState tree. Central dispatch for all node initialization.

ExecProcNode.overview: Central function that processes a single plan node and returns the next tuple, implementing the iterator (Volcano) model via function pointer dispatch.

ExecEndNode.overview: Recursively cleans up all nodes in the plan tree, dispatching on NodeTag to call node-specific cleanup functions.

ExecSetExecProcNode.overview: Sets or changes the execution procedure function for a plan node, installing wrapper functions for stack depth checking and instrumentation.

MultiExecProcNode.overview: Executes plan nodes that return complex data structures (hash tables, bitmaps) rather than individual tuples.

ExecReScan.overview: Central function that resets a plan node so its output can be re-scanned, handling parameter changes and dispatching to node-type-specific rescan functions.

ExecShutdownNode.overview: Provides controlled shutdown for query plan execution trees, allowing nodes to stop asynchronous operations and release resources.

ExecSetTupleBound.overview: Propagates tuple count limits down through a plan tree to enable performance optimizations in child nodes (e.g., top-N sort).

ExecScan.overview: Core tuple processing function that coordinates tuple retrieval, qualification checking (ExecQual), and projection (ExecProject) for all scan node types.

ExecSeqScan.overview: Main execution function for sequential scans that retrieves the next qualifying tuple by delegating to ExecScan with sequential scan-specific access methods.

ExecInitSeqScan.overview: Initializes a sequential scan node by creating the execution state, setting up the scan relation, and initializing tuple slots and projection.

ExecIndexScan.overview: Main execution function for index scans that retrieves tuples from an index while handling runtime keys and ordering requirements.

ExecInitIndexScan.overview: Initializes the execution state for an index scan node, setting up scan keys, opening relations, and preparing data structures.

ExecIndexOnlyScan.overview: Execution function for index-only scans that retrieves tuples directly from the index without accessing the heap when possible.

ExecInitIndexOnlyScan.overview: Initializes execution state for an index-only scan node, setting up scan keys, opening relations, and configuring for index-only access.

ExecBitmapHeapScan.overview: Execution function for bitmap heap scans that fetches qualifying tuples from heap pages identified by a TIDBitmap.

ExecInitBitmapHeapScan.overview: Initializes a bitmap heap scan execution node by setting up state, opening relations, and initializing child bitmap index scan nodes.

ExecInitBitmapIndexScan.overview: Initializes a bitmap index scan node by setting up execution state, opening index, building scan keys, and preparing the index scan descriptor.

MultiExecBitmapIndexScan.overview: Builds a TIDBitmap by scanning the index, returning the bitmap structure rather than individual tuples.

ExecNestLoop.overview: Executes a nested loop join between outer and inner relations, returning tuples that satisfy join and qualification conditions with support for parameterized rescans.

ExecInitNestLoop.overview: Initializes a NestLoopState for nested loop joins, setting up child plan nodes, expression contexts, and join-specific state.

ExecMergeJoin.overview: Core execution function implementing the merge join algorithm using a sophisticated state machine (EXEC_MJ_* states) to join two pre-sorted input streams.

ExecInitMergeJoin.overview: Initializes a MergeJoinState by setting up data structures, expression contexts, child nodes, and join-specific configuration.

ExecHashJoinImpl.overview: Core Hybrid Hash Join implementation handling both parallel and non-parallel execution through an inline-optimized state machine with build and probe phases.

ExecInitHashJoin.overview: Initializes a HashJoin node during query plan startup, setting up state structures, child nodes, expression contexts, and tuple slots.

ExecHashTableCreate.overview: Creates and initializes an empty hash table for hash join operations, configuring memory contexts, hash functions, and batch processing parameters.

MultiExecHash.overview: Main execution function for Hash nodes that builds hash tables for hash joins, supporting both single-backend and parallel execution with optional batching.

ExecScanHashBucket.overview: Scans a hash bucket for tuples matching the current outer tuple in a hash join, handling both regular and skew buckets.

ExecHashJoinNewBatch.overview: Switches to the next batch in a multi-batch hash join, loading the saved inner tuples and preparing for probing.

ExecInitHash.overview: Initializes the HashState structure, child nodes, and hash key expressions for hash table construction.

ExecAgg.overview: Main execution function for aggregate nodes that processes tuples according to the chosen strategy: AGG_PLAIN, AGG_SORTED, AGG_HASHED, or AGG_MIXED.

ExecInitAgg.overview: Initializes aggregate execution state including data structures, memory contexts, function lookups, and hash tables for aggregate computation.

ExecWindowAgg.overview: Main execution function for window aggregation that processes tuples through a tuplestore and evaluates window functions, producing exactly the same number of output rows as input.

ExecInitWindowAgg.overview: Initializes WindowAgg execution nodes, setting up window function processing infrastructure, frame management, and run condition evaluation.

ExecModifyTable.overview: Main execution function for ModifyTable that processes INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE operations while handling triggers, tuple routing, and RETURNING clauses.

ExecInitModifyTable.overview: Initializes ModifyTable plan node execution state for DML operations including result relations, triggers, constraints, projections, and partitioning.

ExecInsert.overview: Handles insertion of a single tuple into a table/partition and its indexes, supporting foreign tables, batch inserts, ON CONFLICT handling, and RETURNING.

ExecUpdate.overview: Main function for executing UPDATE operations, handling regular table updates, foreign table updates, view updates, and cross-partition updates.

ExecDelete.overview: Executes deletion of a tuple from a table, handling foreign tables, triggers, concurrent modifications, and RETURNING clauses.

ExecMerge.overview: Performs MERGE operations handling both MATCHED and NOT MATCHED cases including concurrent update scenarios.

ExecOnConflictUpdate.overview: Handles the UPDATE portion of INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE by locking and updating the conflicting tuple if the ON CONFLICT condition is satisfied.

ExecCrossPartitionUpdate.overview: Handles cross-partition UPDATE operations by deleting from the source partition and inserting into the destination partition.

ExecFindPartition.overview: Returns the ResultRelInfo for the leaf partition a tuple belongs to, performing partition key evaluation and hierarchy traversal.

ExecPrepareTupleRouting.overview: Prepares for routing a tuple to the appropriate partition by determining the target and converting tuple format if necessary.

ExecInitPartitionInfo.overview: Locks a partition and initializes a complete ResultRelInfo for it, setting up indexes, constraints, projections, and conflict handling.

ExecInitPartitionPruning.overview: Initializes data structures for runtime partition pruning and performs initial pruning during executor startup.

ExecBatchInsert.overview: Inserts a batch of tuples into a table using the table AM batch insert interface for better performance.

InitResultRelInfo.overview: Initializes a ResultRelInfo structure for a result relation in DML operations.

EvalPlanQual.overview: Implements EvalPlanQual mechanism to recheck modified tuples under READ COMMITTED isolation level.

ExecSort.overview: Executes tuple sorting operations using tuplesort, optimized for single-column datum sorts versus multi-column tuple sorts.

ExecInitSort.overview: Initializes the runtime state for a Sort plan node, creating the SortState and setting up execution parameters.

ExecIncrementalSort.overview: Execution function for incremental sort that sorts groups of presorted tuples, avoiding full materialization.

ExecMaterial.overview: Materializes tuples from an outer plan into a tuplestore, returning them one at a time on subsequent calls.

ExecMemoize.overview: Implements memoization of results from a parameterized plan node, caching results indexed by parameter values.

ExecResult.overview: Core execution function for the Result plan node that returns tuples from an outer plan or generates tuples from constant expressions.

ExecAppend.overview: Main execution function for Append nodes iterating over multiple subplans, supporting synchronous and asynchronous execution modes.

ExecInitAppend.overview: Initializes the Append node execution state including runtime partition pruning and subplan setup.

ExecLimit.overview: Implements LIMIT/OFFSET filtering via a state machine that controls tuple flow from a subplan.

ExecRecursiveUnion.overview: Execution function for recursive union implementing WITH RECURSIVE queries through iterative fixed-point computation.

ExecProjectSet.overview: Execution function for ProjectSet nodes that evaluate set-returning functions in the target list.

ExecGroup.overview: Execution function for Group nodes that filters duplicate groups from pre-sorted input.

ExecUnique.overview: Execution function for Unique nodes that filters duplicate tuples from pre-sorted input.

ExecSetOp.overview: Execution function for set operations (INTERSECT, EXCEPT) using sorted or hashed strategies.

ExecLockRows.overview: Execution function for LockRows nodes that acquires row-level locks for SELECT FOR UPDATE/SHARE.

ExecGather.overview: Main execution function for Gather plan nodes coordinating parallel query execution by collecting tuples from multiple worker processes.

ExecInitGather.overview: Initializes execution state for Gather plan nodes for coordinating parallel query execution.

ExecGatherMerge.overview: Execution function for GatherMerge nodes that collects and merge-sorts tuples from parallel worker processes.

ExecInitGatherMerge.overview: Initializes GatherMerge node execution state for merge-sorting tuples from parallel workers.

ExecParallelInitializeDSM.overview: Recursively traverses a plan tree initializing the DSM segment for each plan node requiring shared memory coordination in parallel execution.

ExecParallelCreateReaders.overview: Creates TupleQueueReader objects for each launched parallel worker, enabling reading of results from shared memory queues.

ParallelQueryMain.overview: Main entrypoint for parallel query worker processes that executes the serialized query plan and writes results to the tuple queue.

ExecInitExpr.overview: Prepares an expression tree for execution by building and returning an ExprState implementing the given expression node tree.

ExecInitExprRec.overview: Core recursive function that compiles expression nodes into execution steps, generating a sequence of ExprEvalStep operations.

ExecInitQual.overview: Prepares a conjunctive boolean expression (qualification list) for execution by ExecQual, optimized for WHERE clause evaluation.

ExecEvalExpr.overview: Primary interface for evaluating SQL expressions, delegating to compiled evaluation functions (ExecInterpExpr or JIT-compiled functions).

ExecInterpExpr.overview: Core interpreter function that executes expressions by evaluating a sequence of ExprEvalStep opcodes in a switch/computed-goto dispatch loop.

ExecQual.overview: Evaluates a qualification (boolean) expression and returns true/false, the core function for WHERE clause evaluation.

ExecProject.overview: Performs tuple projection by evaluating target list expressions and constructing a result tuple in the target slot.

ExecBuildProjectionInfo.overview: Builds a ProjectionInfo node for evaluating a target list in a given expression context and storing results into a tuple slot.

ExecBuildAggTrans.overview: Builds compiled expression state for aggregate transition computation, used by aggregate execution.

ExecInitInterpreter.overview: One-time initialization for the expression evaluation interpreter, setting up dispatch tables for computed goto optimization.

TupleTableSlot.overview: Core data structure for storing tuples in the executor. Supports virtual, heap, minimal, and buffer tuple slot types via the TupleTableSlotOps vtable.

TupleTableSlotOps.overview: Virtual method table for TupleTableSlot operations: init, release, clear, getsomeattrs, getsysattr, materialize, copyslot, get_heap_tuple, etc.

ExecStoreHeapTuple.overview: Stores a physical HeapTuple into a TTSOpsHeapTuple type slot with configurable memory ownership.

ExecStoreMinimalTuple.overview: Stores a MinimalTuple into a TTSOpsMinimalTuple type slot, optimized path for minimal tuples.

ExecStoreVirtualTuple.overview: Marks a TupleTableSlot as containing a valid virtual tuple after the caller has populated Datum/isnull arrays.

ExecStoreBufferHeapTuple.overview: Stores a HeapTuple that resides in a disk buffer page into a BufferHeapTupleTableSlot, maintaining a pin on the buffer.

ExecClearTuple.overview: Clears the contents of a TupleTableSlot, making it empty and ready for reuse.

ExecMaterializeSlot.overview: Forces a slot into the materialized state, making the tuple a local copy independent of external storage.

slot_getsomeattrs_int.overview: Internal workhorse that ensures a TupleTableSlot has valid values for all attributes up to a specified number.

ExecInitResultTupleSlotTL.overview: Convenience function that initializes both the result tuple descriptor and result tuple slot for a plan node using the plan's target list.

ExecInitScanTupleSlot.overview: Initializes the scan tuple slot for a scan node with a specified tuple descriptor and slot operations.

MakeTupleTableSlot.overview: Low-level function to create a new TupleTableSlot with a specific tuple descriptor and operations.

CreateExecutorState.overview: Creates and initializes an EState node, the root of working storage for an entire Executor invocation including the per-query memory context.

FreeExecutorState.overview: Releases an EState with all working storage, cleaning up expression contexts, JIT resources, and the per-query memory context.

CreateExprContext.overview: Creates a standard ExprContext for expression evaluation within an EState with per-query and per-tuple memory contexts.

ExecAssignExprContext.overview: Creates an ExprContext and assigns it to a plan node's ps_ExprContext field.

QueryDesc.overview: Structure that encapsulates everything the executor needs to execute a query: planned statement, snapshots, destination, parameters, and runtime state.

CreateQueryDesc.overview: Constructs and initializes a QueryDesc structure encapsulating all information needed to execute a planned query statement.

EState.overview: Per-query execution state containing snapshots, range tables, result relations, parameters, memory contexts, and all working state for the executor.

PlanState.overview: Base state node for all executor plan nodes, containing the plan pointer, EState reference, ExecProcNode function pointer, instrumentation, qual, subtrees, and projection info.

ExprContext.overview: Holds current context for expression evaluation including scan/inner/outer tuple slots, memory contexts, parameter values, and aggregate values.

ExprState.overview: Compiled expression state containing an array of ExprEvalStep operations and the evalfunc function pointer for expression evaluation.

ProjectionInfo.overview: Information for tuple projection containing the ExprState for computing the target list and the expression context.

PortalRunSelect.overview: Executes a portal's query in SELECT mode, handling both forward and backward access by bridging to ExecutorRun.

InstrAlloc.overview: Allocates and initializes Instrumentation structures for query execution performance monitoring (EXPLAIN ANALYZE).

InstrStartNode.overview: Captures starting state for performance instrumentation when entering a plan node, recording timing and buffer usage baselines.

InstrStopNode.overview: Completes performance instrumentation when exiting a plan node, calculating elapsed time and resource consumption.

SPI_connect.overview: Establishes a connection to PostgreSQL's Server Programming Interface, enabling stored procedures and functions to execute SQL within the server.

SPI_execute.overview: Parses, plans, and executes a SQL query string, providing a high-level interface for internal SQL execution.

SPI_execute_plan.overview: Executes a previously prepared SQL plan with parameter values for parameterized query execution.

SPI_prepare.overview: Parses and plans a SQL query with parameter placeholders, returning a reusable plan for repeated execution.

SPI_finish.overview: Disconnects from the Server Programming Interface, cleaning up SPI state and restoring the previous memory context.

ExecInitSubPlan.overview: Initializes a SubPlanState for executing subplans/initplans, setting up hash tables, projection nodes, and equality functions.

ExecSubPlan.overview: Main execution function for SubPlan nodes, handling correlated and uncorrelated subqueries.

ExecCheckPermissions.overview: Checks table-level permissions for all range table entries, with a plugin hook for custom permission checking.

ExecConstraints.overview: Checks NOT NULL constraints and checks constraints for a tuple being inserted or updated.

ExecInsertIndexTuples.overview: Inserts index entries for a newly inserted or updated tuple, checking for constraint violations.

ExecOpenIndices.overview: Opens all indexes for a result relation to prepare for index tuple insertion.

ExecWithCheckOptions.overview: Verifies WITH CHECK OPTION constraints for views and security barriers.

ExecInitStoredGenerated.overview: Initializes computation of GENERATED ALWAYS AS stored columns for a result relation.

ExecComputeStoredGenerated.overview: Computes values of GENERATED ALWAYS AS stored columns for a tuple being inserted or updated.

ExecSetupTransitionCaptureState.overview: Sets up trigger transition table capture state for AFTER triggers with transition tables.

BuildTupleHashTable.overview: Creates a hash table for tuple grouping operations, used by aggregation and set operations.

ExecScanReScan.overview: Generic rescan function for scan nodes, resetting the scan descriptor and clearing the scan tuple.

ExecAssignScanProjectionInfo.overview: Sets up projection info for a scan node based on whether the scan tuple matches the target list.

ExecOpenScanRelation.overview: Opens a scan relation for a scan node, acquiring the appropriate lock.

TTSOpsVirtual.overview: TupleTableSlotOps implementation for virtual tuple slots that store only Datum/isnull arrays without a physical tuple.

TTSOpsBufferHeapTuple.overview: TupleTableSlotOps implementation for tuples residing in disk buffer pages, maintaining buffer pins.

TTSOpsMinimalTuple.overview: TupleTableSlotOps implementation for MinimalTuple slots used in hash joins and aggregation.

TTSOpsHeapTuple.overview: TupleTableSlotOps implementation for palloc'd HeapTuple slots.

ExecInitMerge.overview: Initializes MERGE-specific execution state within ModifyTable, setting up action lists for MATCHED and NOT MATCHED clauses.

ExecMergeMatched.overview: Handles the MATCHED case of MERGE, evaluating conditions and dispatching to UPDATE or DELETE actions.

ExecMergeNotMatched.overview: Handles the NOT MATCHED case of MERGE, evaluating conditions and dispatching to INSERT actions.

critical_paths.name: Executor Startup
critical_paths.description: Query execution initialization: building plan state tree from plan tree

critical_paths.name: Tuple Fetch (Sequential Scan)
critical_paths.description: Pull-model tuple retrieval from a sequential scan through qualification and projection

critical_paths.name: Hash Join Execution
critical_paths.description: Two-phase hash join: build hash table then probe for matches

critical_paths.name: Nested Loop Join
critical_paths.description: Nested loop with parameterized inner rescan

critical_paths.name: Merge Join Execution
critical_paths.description: Merge join state machine processing sorted inputs

critical_paths.name: Aggregation Pipeline
critical_paths.description: Hash or sorted aggregation with transition and final functions

critical_paths.name: ModifyTable (INSERT)
critical_paths.description: Tuple insertion with partition routing, constraints, triggers, and index updates

critical_paths.name: Parallel Gather
critical_paths.description: Parallel query coordination: DSM setup, worker launch, tuple collection

critical_paths.name: Executor Shutdown
critical_paths.description: Clean shutdown of the entire executor tree
